boards.prompt: Create a wide landscape production concept board for a Minecraft Bedrock voxel hospital add-on. This is a strict modeling blueprint. Use clean orthographic-style three-quarter voxel geometry on a light neutral gray background, finite stepped contours and visibly separated components. Equal-sized separated panels with no overlap, exact numbered English headings only, no invented brands unless specified. Show each item large, full footprint visible, with a second small side or back view of the same item, same proportions and same parts. All screens are static mock graphics, no patients, no hands, no blood, no diagnostic instructions. Draw consistently stylized recognizable functional shells, not photorealism. Geometry must translate to <=256 simple cuboids per device, 128px texture, not rounded sculpture. Primary screen facing the viewer. Give each machine a visually distinctive silhouette and strong readable components. Exactly three panels left to right. 01 CT SCANNER: front-facing octagonal white gantry with an actually open bore, powder blue outer side trim, fixed narrow scan couch extending in front on a central rectangular pedestal. 02 CTA STATION: distinct charcoal and turquoise wide-bore octagonal gantry, fixed examination couch with a differently shaped flat base, dual-head contrast injector with two visible capped clear cylinders and small screen attached near couch at one side, within footprint. 03 DSA ANGIOGRAPHY: open asymmetric stepped C-arm from a rear pedestal with top detector and underside source, long dark floating flat tabletop with support and dual suspended monitors, no closed gantry ring. All three fit 2 blocks wide × 3 blocks deep, up to 3 blocks tall. Show distinct device footprints and scale on subtle 2-by-3 grid plinths.
